Bea (docs): Doing a pass on Optimize toolkit pages; found some link rot and a confusing quant name situation. Opening a small docfix PR to reconcile names and refresh SDK snippets.
Bea (docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 — small, mostly examples + a short migration blurb.
Ravi (eng-ml): What are you seeing with the quant names?
Bea (docs): Docs sometimes call the 4-bit profile 'q4-fast' while runtime logs and model registry use 'q4_0'. That confuses support. Plan: pick 'q4_0' as canonical docs name and list the alternate runtime names in a tiny mapping.
Jo (devex): Also saw the Node examples using the old callback streaming. We should show the async iterator pattern and a tiny note about backpressure for UI usages.
Alex (engineer): I can PR a compact Python example for recommended batching + prefix cache that fits the code sandbox. Keep it minimal so engineers can paste into guides.
Alex (engineer): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# preferred: adaptive batching for mixed load, prefix cache for short prompt reuse
resp = client.generate('Summarize main points', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=100, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Bea (docs): Nice. Can you add a one-liner table in the PR describing batch_policy options (none | fixed-N | adaptive) and the default?
Alex (engineer): Yep, will add. Also proposing this YAML mapping for quant aliases to reduce support churn:
```yaml
quant_profile_aliases:
  q4_0: [q4f, q4-fast]
  q8_1: [q8_1]
```
Ravi (eng-ml): Looks good. Please make sure the text explains that quant profiles affect memory and latency tradeoffs but don't change model weights/accuracy.
Marta (support): Adding: we had two tickets this month where customers saw "q4f" in logs and couldn't find docs. If you add a tiny FAQ line like "If your logs show 'q4f', refer to q4_0 in docs", that'll cut tickets.
deploy-bot: PR 1422 opened by @bea/docs: "optimize: reconcile quant names, refresh snippets"  CI: docs-lint passed :white_check_mark:
Jo (devex): TS streaming example I'll add to the PR: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Short summary' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
Bea (docs): Great teamwork. Plan: Alex add Python + YAML, Jo update Node snippet, Ravi tech checks quant wording, Marta confirms FAQ covers support cases. I'll merge once everyone +1s. Target: EOD tomorrow.
Ravi (eng-ml): Quick pass done; suggested one wording tweak to avoid implying quant improves accuracy.
Alex (engineer): Pushed updated snippet + batch_policy one-liner.
Jo (devex): TS snippet added and linked to SDK reference. Also added a note about when streaming is preferred.
Marta (support): Approved; FAQ sentence added to PR comment.
Bea (docs): Merged. Changelog: "Optimize: canonicalize quant profile name to q4_0, refresh batching/caching snippets, add migration FAQ and Node streaming example."
deploy-bot: PR 1422 merged by @bea/docs  docs deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:
Marta (support): Confirmed a closed ticket after update  thanks all!
Bea (docs): I'll follow up in a week to see if any other inconsistency pops up. :sparkles:
